acceptance_criteria.name: unattended_execution_proof
acceptance_criteria.pass_condition: The dry-run starts from a single command or one-shot scheduled invocation, completes without interactive input, and emits a terminal summary with exit status.

acceptance_criteria.name: side_effect_zero
acceptance_criteria.pass_condition: Every emitted safety invariant remains read-only and all side-effect flags are false.

acceptance_criteria.name: bounded_runtime_and_scope
acceptance_criteria.pass_condition: Runtime, repeat count, write roots, input files, and output files stay within the declared bounds.

acceptance_criteria.name: reviewable_artifact_packet
acceptance_criteria.pass_condition: JSON and Markdown summaries exist, parse/read back, and include source inputs, statuses, safety flags, and recommended next action.

acceptance_criteria.name: formal_completion_gate_not_weakened
acceptance_criteria.pass_condition: The report distinguishes read-only dry-run success from full formal completion unless a separately approved optimizer/handoff cycle also passes or is explicitly waived.
